findings.title: Cookie set with httpOnly disabled
findings.fixPrompt:
Fix one warning security issue that DeployReady found in this project.

Where: server.js:9
Issue: Cookie set with httpOnly disabled (CWE-1004, A05:2025)
What to change: Set httpOnly:true on session/auth cookies so client-side JS cannot read them, plus secure:true and an appropriate sameSite.

Keep the fix minimal: change only what this issue needs, do not change behaviour or refactor unrelated code, and never put real secrets in code or in your reply (use environment variables).
To confirm: re-run `npx deployready@latest analyze` and check this issue is gone, or call the DeployReady MCP `verify` tool with id "284ec2750757".
